// BEGIN src/vegetation.js
// Construcció visual de vegetació instanciada. Col·lisions i destrucció continuen al nucli.
window.HUNTER_VEGETATION=Object.freeze({
  create(THREE,{materialProfile,random}){
    const dum=new THREE.Object3D();
    // La punta de les tres malles de tronc és a la mateixa alçada.
    // L'última secció del tronc detallat va de t=7/8 a t=1:
    // prenem la seva tangent en lloc d'inclinar arbitràriament la copa.
    const PALM_HEIGHT=6.2,TRUNK_BEND=.25,TRUNK_SECTIONS=8;
    const lastT=(TRUNK_SECTIONS-1)/TRUNK_SECTIONS;
    const lastDx=-Math.sin(Math.PI*lastT)*PALM_HEIGHT*TRUNK_BEND;
    const lastDy=PALM_HEIGHT/TRUNK_SECTIONS;
    const lastAngle=Math.atan2(-lastDx,lastDy);
    const crownPivot=new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(0,PALM_HEIGHT,0),
          crownUnpivot=new THREE.Matrix4().makeTranslation(0,-PALM_HEIGHT,0),
          crownTurn=new THREE.Matrix4(),trunkMatrix=new THREE.Matrix4(),
          crownMatrix=new THREE.Matrix4();
    // Variació estable derivada de cada palmera, sense consumir RNG global
    // ni alterar les llavors, els spawns o la cerca de seeds.
    const palmVariation=(row,salt=0)=>{
      const x=row[0]||0,z=row[2]||0,r=row[4]||0;
      const n=Math.sin(x*(12.9898+salt*.037)+
        z*(78.233+salt*.13)+r*(37.719+salt*.21))*43758.5453;
      return n-Math.floor(n);
    };
    // Cada fulla té un to propi. Colors de vèrtex compartits a totes les
    // instàncies: marrons secs puntuals, verds clars, oliva i verd base.
    const frondColor=(index,count,layer=0)=>{
      const k=(index*13+count*7+layer*11)%23;
      const palettes=layer?[
        0x4e923a,0x82b85e,0x718347,0x947746
      ]:[
        0x367d35,0x70af54,0x657849,0x856941
      ];
      return new THREE.Color(palettes[k<2?3:k<5?2:k<9?1:0]);
    };
    const paintFrond=(colors,color,vertexCount)=>{
      for(let n=0;n<vertexCount;n++)colors.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
    };
    const palmCrown=(radius,rise,segments=8,phase=0)=>{
      const pos=[],colors=[];
      for(let j=0;j<segments;j++){
        const a=phase+j*Math.PI*2/segments,
              tint=frondColor(j,segments,rise>0?1:0);
        for(let k=0;k<4;k++){
          const t=k/4,u=(k+1)/4;
          const point=(v,side)=>{
            const len=radius*v,w=Math.sin(v*Math.PI)*.68*side;
            return [
              Math.cos(a)*len-Math.sin(a)*w,
              6.35+rise+Math.sin(v*Math.PI)*1.05-v*v*1.75,
              Math.sin(a)*len+Math.cos(a)*w
            ]
          };
          const p0=point(t,-1),p1=point(t,1),p2=point(u,-1),p3=point(u,1);
          pos.push(...p0,...p1,...p2,...p1,...p3,...p2);
          paintFrond(colors,tint,6);
        }
      }
      const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
      g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
      g.computeVertexNormals();
      return g
    };
    const curvedPalmTrunk=(height=6.2,baseRadius=.42,topRadius=.22,radial=6,vertical=8,bend=.25)=>{
      const pos=[],idx=[];
      for(let iy=0;iy<=vertical;iy++){
        const t=iy/vertical,y=height*t,r=baseRadius+(topRadius-baseRadius)*t,
              // Arc suau: arrel i copa tornen a l'eix; desviació màxima al centre.
              cx=Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*height*bend;
        for(let j=0;j<radial;j++){
          const a=j*Math.PI*2/radial;
          pos.push(cx+Math.cos(a)*r,y,Math.sin(a)*r)
        }
      }
      for(let iy=0;iy<vertical;iy++)for(let j=0;j<radial;j++){
        const a=iy*radial+j,b=iy*radial+(j+1)%radial,
              c=(iy+1)*radial+j,d=(iy+1)*radial+(j+1)%radial;
        idx.push(a,c,b,b,c,d)
      }
      // Tapes inferior i superior.
      const bottom=pos.length/3;pos.push(0,0,0);
      const top=pos.length/3;pos.push(0,height,0);
      for(let j=0;j<radial;j++){
        const n=(j+1)%radial;
        idx.push(bottom,n,j);
        const a=vertical*radial+j,b=vertical*radial+n;
        idx.push(top,a,b)
      }
      const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
      g.setIndex(idx);g.computeVertexNormals();
      return g
    };
    // Caps simplificats sense transparències, billboards ni actualitzacions
    // per fotograma. Els grups distant són InstancedMesh per sector.
    const reducedCrown=(fronds,radius=4.65)=>{
      const pos=[],colors=[];
      for(let j=0;j<fronds;j++){
        const a=j*Math.PI*2/fronds,tint=frondColor(j,fronds);
        const point=(v,side)=>{
          const len=radius*v,width=Math.sin(v*Math.PI)*.62*side;
          const y=6.35+Math.sin(v*Math.PI)*.7-v*v*1.65;
          return [Math.cos(a)*len-Math.sin(a)*width,y,
                  Math.sin(a)*len+Math.cos(a)*width];
        };
        for(let k=0;k<2;k++){
          const v0=k/2,v1=(k+1)/2,
                a0=point(v0,-1),a1=point(v0,1),
                b0=point(v1,-1),b1=point(v1,1);
          pos.push(...a0,...a1,...b0,...a1,...b1,...b0);
          paintFrond(colors,tint,6);
        }
      }
      const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
      geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
      geo.computeVertexNormals();
      return geo;
    };
    const crossedCrown=()=>{
      // Tres bandes planes creuades: 6 triangles en total i silueta verda
      // recognoscible de qualsevol angle, sense orientar-les a la càmera.
      const pos=[],colors=[],r=4.25;
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
        const a=i*Math.PI/3,dx=Math.cos(a),dz=Math.sin(a),
              tint=new THREE.Color(i===0?0x45853b:0x739d53),
              wx=-dz*.72,wz=dx*.72;
        const left=[-dx*r+wx,4.95,-dz*r+wz],
              right=[dx*r+wx,4.95,dz*r+wz],
              left2=[-dx*r-wx,4.95,-dz*r-wz],
              right2=[dx*r-wx,4.95,dz*r-wz],
              middle=[0,6.6,0];
        pos.push(...left,...middle,...left2,...right2,...middle,...right);
        paintFrond(colors,tint,6);
      }
      const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
      geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
      geo.computeVertexNormals();
      return geo;
    };
    // Dos perfils irregulars compartits: B baix/estratificat i D alt/angular.
    // 36 i 20 triangles respectivament, deformació determinista per vèrtex.
    const rockShape=kind=>{
      const g=kind===0?new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1,0):
        new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,0);
      const a=g.getAttribute('position');
      for(let i=0;i<a.count;i++){
        const x=a.getX(i),y=a.getY(i),z=a.getZ(i),
          irregular=1+.13*Math.sin(x*5.1+z*2.9)+.10*Math.cos(z*4.4-y*3.5);
        a.setXYZ(i,x*(kind?1.12:1.34)*irregular,
          y*(kind?1.36:.63)*irregular,
          z*(kind?1.14:1.11)*irregular);
      }
      a.needsUpdate=true;g.computeVertexNormals();return g;
    };
    const geometry={
      trunk:curvedPalmTrunk(6.2,.42,.22,6,8,.25),
      // LOD 1: 4 cares, 3 seccions i 6 fulles planes.
      midTrunk:curvedPalmTrunk(6.2,.42,.22,4,3,.25),
      midCrown:reducedCrown(6),
      // LOD 2: 3 cares, 2 seccions i 3 plans de copa creuats.
      farTrunk:curvedPalmTrunk(6.2,.42,.22,3,2,.25),
      farCrown:crossedCrown(),
      crown:palmCrown(4.7,0,8),
      crown2:palmCrown(3.1,.65,7,.18),
      palmVariants:[
        {crown:palmCrown(4.7,0,6),crown2:palmCrown(3.1,.65,5,.18)},
        {crown:palmCrown(4.7,0,8),crown2:palmCrown(3.1,.65,7,.18)},
        {crown:palmCrown(4.7,0,10),crown2:palmCrown(3.1,.65,9,.18)}
      ],
      bush:new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1.15,1).translate(0,.62,0),
      rock:rockShape(0), rockTall:rockShape(1)
    };
    const colorFor=(base,row)=>{
      const c=new THREE.Color(base),tone=Math.max(-.25,Math.min(.25,row?.[6]||0));
      c.multiplyScalar(1+tone);
      c.offsetHSL(random(-.018,.018),random(-.045,.045),random(-.025,.025));
      return c
    };
    // Reutilitzem materials entre sectors perquè cada grup no generi
    // programes i materials nous innecessàriament.
    const cache=new Map();
    const mat=(color,opts={})=>{
      const key=color+':'+(opts.doubleSide?1:0)+':'+(opts.vertexColors?1:0)+':'+(opts.profile||'organic');
      if(!cache.has(key))cache.set(key,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color:0xffffff,flatShading:true,vertexColors:!!opts.vertexColors,
        side:opts.doubleSide?THREE.DoubleSide:THREE.FrontSide,
        ...materialProfile(opts.profile||'organic')
      }));
      return cache.get(key);
    };
    function* inst(parent,geo,arr,color,scale,opts={}){
      if(!arr.length)return null;
      const m=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo,mat(color,opts),arr.length);
      parent.add(m);
      for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++){
        if(i%64===0)yield {stage:'Instàncies de vegetació',completed:i,total:arr.length,unit:'instàncies'};
        const row=arr[i];
        const [x,y,z,s,r]=row;
        if(opts.crownTrunk){
          // Alineació amb el tronc real (inclosa la seva lleugera
          // inclinació aleatòria). El gir pivota a la punta del tronc:
          // la copa no es desplaça ni se separa quan s'inclina.
          opts.crownTrunk.getMatrixAt(opts.trunkIndices[i],trunkMatrix);
          const strength=.5+.3*palmVariation(row),
                deviation=(palmVariation(row,1)-.5)*.14,
                tilt=lastAngle*strength+deviation;
          crownTurn.makeRotationZ(tilt);
          crownMatrix.copy(trunkMatrix).multiply(crownPivot)
            .multiply(crownTurn).multiply(crownUnpivot);
          m.setMatrixAt(i,crownMatrix);
        }else{
          dum.position.set(x,y,z);
          dum.rotation.set(
            opts.tilt?random(-.04,.04):0,
            r,
            opts.tilt?random(-.04,.04):0
          );
          if(scale)scale(dum,s,row);else dum.scale.setScalar(s);
          dum.updateMatrix();
          m.setMatrixAt(i,dum.matrix);
        }
        // Es mantenen tres tirades de color per instància com abans.
        // La variació individual de les fulles viu als vertexColors.
        m.setColorAt(i,colorFor(opts.vertexColors?0xf2f5e9:color,row));
      }
      m.computeBoundingSphere();
      m.castShadow=false;
      m.receiveShadow=true;
      m.frustumCulled=true;
      parent.add(m);
      return m;
    };
    // Reutilitzem exactament les transformacions i colors de les instàncies
    // completes. Cap crida nova a random(): llavors i spawns idèntics.
    const cloneInstances=(parent,geo,source)=>{
      if(!source)return null;
      const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo,source.material,source.count),
            matrix=new THREE.Matrix4(),color=new THREE.Color();
      for(let i=0;i<source.count;i++){
        source.getMatrixAt(i,matrix);mesh.setMatrixAt(i,matrix);
        if(source.instanceColor){source.getColorAt(i,color);mesh.setColorAt(i,color)}
      }
      mesh.computeBoundingSphere();
      mesh.castShadow=false;mesh.receiveShadow=false;
      mesh.userData.palmSimplified=true;
      mesh.frustumCulled=true;
      parent.add(mesh);return mesh;
    };
    const cloneCrowns=(parent,geo,rows,ch,refs)=>{
      if(!rows.length)return null;
      const mesh=new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo,mat(0xffffff,{doubleSide:true,vertexColors:true}),rows.length),
            matrix=new THREE.Matrix4(),color=new THREE.Color();
      for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
        const ref=refs[rows[i].i],source=ch.primary[ref.variant];
        source.getMatrixAt(ref.index,matrix);mesh.setMatrixAt(i,matrix);
        source.getColorAt(ref.index,color);mesh.setColorAt(i,color);
      }
      mesh.computeBoundingSphere();
      mesh.castShadow=false;mesh.receiveShadow=false;
      mesh.userData.palmSimplified=true;mesh.frustumCulled=true;
      parent.add(mesh);return mesh;
    };
    const CHUNK=420;
    function* buildSteps({world,palms,bushes,rocks,playerX=0,playerZ=0,lowQuality=false,lodProfile=null}){
      const root=new THREE.Group();
      root.name='hunter-palm-sectors';
      world.add(root);
      const chunks=new Map();
      const variantMap=new Array(palms.length);
      for(let i=0;i<palms.length;i++){
        if(i%256===0)yield {stage:'Sectors de palmeres',completed:i,total:palms.length,unit:'palmeres'};
        const row=palms[i];
        const cx=Math.floor(row[0]/CHUNK),cz=Math.floor(row[2]/CHUNK),
              key=cx+','+cz;
        let ch=chunks.get(key);
        if(!ch){
          ch={cx,cz,x:(cx+.5)*CHUNK,z:(cz+.5)*CHUNK,rows:[],mesh:null,primary:[],secondary:[]};
          chunks.set(key,ch);
        }
        const vi=Math.max(0,Math.min(2,(row[5]??0)+1));
        ch.rows.push({row,i,vi});
      }
      const sections=[];
      for(const ch of chunks.values()){
        // Les posicions i rotacions continuen en coordenades mundials:
        // els límits de l'InstancedMesh es calculen només per aquest sector.
        const rows=ch.rows;
        rows.forEach((p,trunkIndex)=>{
          variantMap[p.i]={chunk:ch,trunkIndex,variant:p.vi,index:-1};
        });
        ch.trunk=yield* inst(root,geometry.trunk,rows.map(p=>p.row),0x8e6337,null,{profile:'organic',tilt:true});
        ch.primary=[];ch.secondary=[];
        for(let v=0;v<3;v++){
          const selected=rows.filter(p=>p.vi===v);
          const crowns=selected.map(p=>p.row),
                crownOpts={doubleSide:true,vertexColors:true,crownTrunk:ch.trunk,
                  trunkIndices:selected.map(p=>variantMap[p.i].trunkIndex)};
          const primary=yield* inst(root,geometry.palmVariants[v].crown,crowns,0xffffff,null,crownOpts);
          const secondary=yield* inst(root,geometry.palmVariants[v].crown2,crowns,0xffffff,null,crownOpts);
          ch.primary.push(primary);ch.secondary.push(secondary);
          selected.forEach((p,i)=>{variantMap[p.i].index=i});
        }
        // LOD 1 i 2 comparteixen posicions i colors del model detallat,
        // però es dibuixen amb només dos InstancedMesh per sector.
        ch.midTrunk=cloneInstances(root,geometry.midTrunk,ch.trunk);
        ch.midCrown=cloneCrowns(root,geometry.midCrown,rows,ch,variantMap);
        ch.farTrunk=cloneInstances(root,geometry.farTrunk,ch.trunk);
        ch.farCrown=cloneCrowns(root,geometry.farCrown,rows,ch,variantMap);
        // Bounding spheres separades per sector, no una esfera de tota l'illa.
        ch.meshes=[ch.trunk,...ch.primary,...ch.secondary,
          ch.midTrunk,ch.midCrown,ch.farTrunk,ch.farCrown].filter(Boolean);
        ch.rows=null;
        sections.push(ch);
        yield {stage:'Sectors de palmeres',completed:sections.length,total:chunks.size,unit:'sectors'};
      }
      // LOD anticipat: el detall complet només es conserva a prop.
      // La distància es mesura fins a la vora del sector, no al centre.
      // Conservam l'abast dels models més simples per evitar illes despullades.
      const profile=lodProfile|| (lowQuality?'mobile':'desktop'),
            distanceProfiles={
              desktop:[485,1240,3080],
              mobile:[315,735,1850],
              ultra:[190,475,1220]
            },
            distances=distanceProfiles[profile]||distanceProfiles.desktop,
            margin=55;
      const stats={profile,sectors:sections.length,totalPalms:palms.length,
        totalBushes:bushes.length,totalRocks:rocks.length,
        bushSectors:0,rockSectors:0,visibleBushes:0,visibleRocks:0,
        visibleSectors:0,visiblePalms:0,detailSectors:0,mediumSectors:0,
        farSectors:0,hiddenSectors:0,lodSwitches:0,
        nearDistance:distances[0],midDistance:distances[1],
        farDistance:distances[2]};
      // Abans els arbustos i les roques formaven DOS InstancedMesh gegants
      // que recorrien tot l'arxipèlag. Un sector llunyà ja no força tota
      // la vegetació baixa a passar pel pipeline de la GPU.
      function* sectorizeExtras(rows,geo,name,color,scale,opts){
        const parent=new THREE.Group();parent.name=name;world.add(parent);
        const groups=new Map();
        for(const row of rows){
          const cx=Math.floor(row[0]/CHUNK),cz=Math.floor(row[2]/CHUNK),
                type=opts.byKind?(row[7]||0):0,
                key=cx+','+cz+(opts.byKind?','+type:'');
          if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{x:(cx+.5)*CHUNK,z:(cz+.5)*CHUNK,type,rows:[]});
          groups.get(key).rows.push(row);
        }
        const result=[];
        for(const g of groups.values()){
          const mesh=yield* inst(parent,opts.byKind?geo[g.type]:geo,g.rows,color,scale,opts);
          if(mesh)result.push({mesh,x:g.x,z:g.z,count:g.rows.length});
        }
        return {parent,sectors:result};
      }
      const bushGroup=yield* sectorizeExtras(bushes,geometry.bush,'hunter-bush-sectors',
        0x2f8e42,(d,s)=>d.scale.set(s*1.15,s*.72,s),{profile:'organic'});
      const rockGroup=yield* sectorizeExtras(rocks,[geometry.rock,geometry.rockTall],
        'hunter-rock-sectors',0x777985,
        (d,s)=>d.scale.setScalar(s),{profile:'masonry',tilt:true,byKind:true});
      const extraRanges={
        desktop:{bush:1300,rock:1900},
        mobile:{bush:710,rock:1180},
        ultra:{bush:440,rock:750}
      }[profile]||{bush:1010,rock:1600};
      stats.bushSectors=bushGroup.sectors.length;
      stats.rockSectors=rockGroup.sectors.length;
      let lastX=Infinity,lastZ=Infinity;
      const tierFor=(d,previous)=>{
        if(previous==null)return d<distances[0]?0:d<distances[1]?1:d<distances[2]?2:3;
        let tier=previous;
        // Histeresi de 55 m evita canvis de malla a cada moviment.
        while(tier<3&&d>distances[tier]+margin)tier++;
        while(tier>0&&d<distances[tier-1]-margin)tier--;
        return tier;
      };
      function update(x,z,force=false,skipPalms=false,focus=null){
        if(!force&&Math.abs(x-lastX)<45&&Math.abs(z-lastZ)<45)return;
        lastX=x;lastZ=z;
        // Frustum culling sobre cada InstancedMesh i clip per distància.
        const distToSector=c=>Math.hypot(
          Math.max(0,Math.abs(c.x-x)-CHUNK/2),
          Math.max(0,Math.abs(c.z-z)-CHUNK/2));
        for(const [extra,maxDist,key] of [
          [bushGroup,extraRanges.bush,'visibleBushes'],
          [rockGroup,extraRanges.rock,'visibleRocks']
        ]){
          let count=0;
          for(const sec of extra.sectors){
            sec.mesh.visible=distToSector(sec)<maxDist||
              !!focus?.intersectsXZBox(sec.x,sec.z,CHUNK/2);
            if(sec.mesh.visible)count+=sec.count;
          }
          stats[key]=count;
        }
        if(skipPalms)return;
        let visible=0,count=0,detailed=0,middle=0,far=0,hidden=0;
        for(const ch of sections){
          // La distància és a la vora del sector, per evitar salts visibles
          // quan el jugador passa a tocar d'una cantonada.
          const dx=Math.max(0,Math.abs(ch.x-x)-CHUNK/2),
                dz=Math.max(0,Math.abs(ch.z-z)-CHUNK/2),
                d=Math.hypot(dx,dz),
                tier=focus?.intersectsXZBox(ch.x,ch.z,CHUNK/2)?0:tierFor(d,ch.lod);
          if(ch.lod!==tier){
            if(ch.lod!=null)stats.lodSwitches++;
            ch.lod=tier;
            for(const mesh of ch.meshes)mesh.visible=false;
            const show=m=>{if(m)m.visible=true};
            if(tier===0){
              show(ch.trunk);
              for(const mesh of ch.primary)show(mesh);
              for(const mesh of ch.secondary)show(mesh);
            }else if(tier===1){show(ch.midTrunk);show(ch.midCrown)}
            else if(tier===2){show(ch.farTrunk);show(ch.farCrown)}
          }
          if(tier===3){hidden++;continue}
          visible++;count+=ch.count;
          if(tier===0)detailed++;
          else if(tier===1)middle++;
          else far++;
        }
        stats.visibleSectors=visible;
        stats.visiblePalms=count;
        stats.detailSectors=detailed;
        stats.mediumSectors=middle;
        stats.farSectors=far;
        stats.hiddenSectors=hidden;
      }
      for(const ch of sections)ch.count=ch.primary.reduce((sum,m)=>sum+(m?.count||0),0);
      function remove(index,zeroMatrix){
        const ref=variantMap[index];
        if(!ref)return;
        const ch=ref.chunk;
        const meshes=[
          [ch.trunk,ref.trunkIndex],
          [ch.primary[ref.variant],ref.index],
          [ch.secondary[ref.variant],ref.index],
          [ch.midTrunk,ref.trunkIndex],[ch.midCrown,ref.trunkIndex],
          [ch.farTrunk,ref.trunkIndex],[ch.farCrown,ref.trunkIndex]
        ];
        for(const [m,i] of meshes)if(m){
          m.setMatrixAt(i,zeroMatrix);
          m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
        }
      }
      update(playerX,playerZ,true);
      return {
        palms:{trunk:root,variants:sections,variantMap,update,remove,stats},
        bushes:bushGroup.parent,
        rocks:rockGroup.parent
      };
    };
    const build=options=>{const steps=buildSteps(options);let next;while(!(next=steps.next()).done){}return next.value};
    return {geometry,build,buildSteps};
  }
});

;
// END src/vegetation.js
// BEGIN src/buildings.js
// Construcció visual d'edificis. Col·lisions, portes, destrucció i navegació romanen al nucli.
window.HUNTER_BUILDINGS=Object.freeze({
  create(THREE,{material,materialProfile,box}){
    const wallMaterial=color=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,flatShading:true,transparent:true,...materialProfile('masonry')});
    const doorMaterial=()=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x704829,flatShading:true,transparent:true,...materialProfile('paint')});
    const addWall=(group,{lx,lz,sx,sz,height,material:mat,y=height/2})=>{
      const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(sx,height,sz),mat);
      mesh.position.set(lx,y,lz);group.add(mesh);return mesh
    };

    // Unifica només decoració immòbil dins el mateix grup de coberta.
    // Els murs, les portes, els graons i les peces destructibles continuen independents.
    const batchStaticRoof=(roof,parts)=>{
      if(!parts.length)return null;
      const buffers=[],counts=[];let total=0;
      for(const mesh of parts){
        mesh.updateMatrix();
        const geom=mesh.geometry.index?mesh.geometry.toNonIndexed():mesh.geometry.clone();
        geom.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrix);
        buffers.push(geom);
        const n=geom.attributes.position.count;counts.push(n);total+=n;
      }
      const mergedGeometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      for(const [name,width] of [['position',3],['normal',3],['uv',2]]){
        const data=new Float32Array(total*width);let offset=0;
        for(let i=0;i<buffers.length;i++){
          const attr=buffers[i].getAttribute(name);
          if(attr)data.set(attr.array,offset);
          offset+=counts[i]*width;
        }
        mergedGeometry.setAttribute(name,new THREE.BufferAttribute(data,width));
      }
      mergedGeometry.computeBoundingSphere();
      const combined=new THREE.Mesh(mergedGeometry,parts[0].material);
      combined.name='hunter-roof-static-batch';combined.userData.roofBatch=true;
      for(const m of parts)roof.remove(m);
      roof.add(combined);
      for(const g of buffers)g.dispose();
      return combined;
    };
    // Porta visual: més estreta i alta, amb llinda real a sobre.
    const addDoor=(group,{lx,lz,sx,sz,height,wallMaterial,doorMaterial,doorHeight=4.4})=>{
      const h=Math.min(doorHeight,Math.max(3.8,height-.65));
      const door=addWall(group,{lx,lz,sx,sz,height:h,material:doorMaterial,y:h/2});
      const lintelHeight=Math.max(0,height-h);
      const lintel=lintelHeight>.05?addWall(group,{
        lx,lz,sx,sz,height:lintelHeight,material:wallMaterial,y:h+lintelHeight/2
      }):null;
      return {door,lintel,doorHeight:h}
    };


    // Batched per material: tres dibuixos (paret, vidre, marcs) en lloc
    // de desenes. Cada façana encara és un únic objectiu destructible.
    const batchWindowWall=(group,parts)=>{
      const byMat=new Map();
      for(const mesh of parts){
        if(!byMat.has(mesh.material))byMat.set(mesh.material,[]);
        byMat.get(mesh.material).push(mesh);
      }
      const batched=[];
      for(const [mat,meshes] of byMat){
        const geos=[],sizes=[];let total=0;
        for(const mesh of meshes){
          mesh.updateMatrix();
          const geo=mesh.geometry.index?mesh.geometry.toNonIndexed():mesh.geometry.clone();
          geo.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrix);
          geos.push(geo);
          const n=geo.attributes.position.count;sizes.push(n);total+=n;
        }
        const merged=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        for(const [attr,width] of [['position',3],['normal',3],['uv',2]]){
          const data=new Float32Array(total*width);let offset=0;
          for(let i=0;i<geos.length;i++){
            const a=geos[i].getAttribute(attr);
            if(a)data.set(a.array,offset);
            offset+=sizes[i]*width;
          }
          merged.setAttribute(attr,new THREE.BufferAttribute(data,width));
        }
        merged.computeBoundingSphere();
        const result=new THREE.Mesh(merged,mat);
        result.name='hunter-window-facade-batch';
        result.userData.windowFacadeBatch=true;
        for(const mesh of meshes){group.remove(mesh);mesh.geometry.dispose()}
        for(const geo of geos)geo.dispose();
        group.add(result);batched.push(result);
      }
      return batched;
    };

    // Façana amb obertures de finestra reals. La paret es construeix al voltant
    // dels buits; el vidre queda lleugerament endins de la cara exterior.
    const addWindowedWall=(group,{lx,lz,sx,sz,height,material:mat})=>{
      const alongX=sx>=sz,L=alongX?sx:sz,T=alongX?sz:sx;
      const count=L>=14?2:1;
      const winW=Math.min(2.7,L/(count*2.65));
      const winH=Math.min(2.15,Math.max(1.75,height*.31));
      const bottom=Math.min(2.35,Math.max(1.75,height*.32));
      const top=bottom+winH;
      const centers=count===2?[-L*.255,L*.255]:[0];
      const parts=[];

      const piece=(center,len,y,h)=>{
        if(len<=.05||h<=.05)return null;
        const x=alongX?lx+center:lx,z=alongX?lz:lz+center;
        const m=addWall(group,{
          lx:x,lz:z,
          sx:alongX?len:T,sz:alongX?T:len,
          height:h,material:mat,y
        });
        parts.push(m);return m
      };

      // Ampit inferior i llinda superior continus.
      piece(0,L,bottom/2,bottom);
      if(height>top)piece(0,L,top+(height-top)/2,height-top);

      // Pilars entre les obertures.
      const intervals=[];
      let cursor=-L/2;
      for(const c of centers){
        const a=c-winW/2,b=c+winW/2;
        intervals.push([cursor,a]);cursor=b
      }
      intervals.push([cursor,L/2]);
      for(const [a,b] of intervals)if(b-a>.05)piece((a+b)/2,b-a,bottom+winH/2,winH);

      // Vidres i marcs: hi ha buit de paret real darrere.
      const glassMat=material(0x3e7185,'glass'),trimMat=material(0xd0bf9c,'masonry');
      const frame=.13,depth=Math.max(.09,T*.18);
      const faceOffset=T*.08;
      for(const c of centers){
        const wx=alongX?lx+c:lx,wz=alongX?lz:lz+c;
        const glass=new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.BoxGeometry(alongX?winW-.18:depth,winH-.18,alongX?depth:winW-.18),
          glassMat
        );
        glass.position.set(
          alongX?wx:lx-faceOffset,
          bottom+winH/2,
          alongX?lz-faceOffset:wz
        );
        group.add(glass);parts.push(glass);

        const addFrame=(center,span,horizontal,offset)=>{
          const m=new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(
              alongX?(horizontal?span:frame):(horizontal?frame:depth*1.5),
              horizontal?frame:winH+frame*2,
              alongX?(horizontal?depth*1.5:depth*1.5):(horizontal?span:frame)
            ),
            trimMat
          );
          if(alongX)m.position.set(lx+center,bottom+winH/2+(horizontal?offset:0),lz-faceOffset*1.4);
          else m.position.set(lx-faceOffset*1.4,bottom+winH/2+(horizontal?offset:0),lz+center);
          group.add(m);parts.push(m)
        };
        addFrame(c,winW+frame*2,true,winH/2+frame/2);
        addFrame(c,winW+frame*2,true,-winH/2-frame/2);

        for(const side of[-1,1]){
          const m=new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.BoxGeometry(alongX?frame:depth*1.5,winH+frame*2,alongX?depth*1.5:frame),
            trimMat
          );
          if(alongX)m.position.set(lx+c+side*(winW/2+frame/2),bottom+winH/2,lz-faceOffset*1.4);
          else m.position.set(lx-faceOffset*1.4,bottom+winH/2,lz+c+side*(winW/2+frame/2));
          group.add(m);parts.push(m)
        }
      }
      return batchWindowWall(group,parts)
    };

    const createShell=({width,depth,height,wallColor,roofColor})=>{
      const group=new THREE.Group(),roofGroup=new THREE.Group(),walls=wallMaterial(wallColor),doors=doorMaterial();
      const floor=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(width+.35,12.3,depth+.35),material(0x756b5d,'masonry'));
      const roof=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(width+1.35,1.15,depth+1.35),material(roofColor,'masonry'));
      floor.position.y=-5.85;roof.position.y=height+.62;group.add(floor,roofGroup);roofGroup.add(roof);

      const rimMat=material(0x3f4650,'masonry'),rimH=.34;
      const rimN=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(width+1.5,rimH,.36),rimMat);
      const rimS=rimN.clone();
      const rimE=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.36,rimH,depth+1.5),rimMat);
      const rimW=rimE.clone();
      rimN.position.set(0,height+1.24,-depth/2-.48);
      rimS.position.set(0,height+1.24,depth/2+.48);
      rimE.position.set(width/2+.48,height+1.24,0);
      rimW.position.set(-width/2-.48,height+1.24,0);
      roofGroup.add(rimN,rimS,rimE,rimW);
      batchStaticRoof(roofGroup,[rimN,rimS,rimE,rimW]);
      roofGroup.userData.color=roofColor;
      return {group,walls,doors,roof:roofGroup,foundation:floor};
    };

    // Hangar de gran llum amb coberta arquejada low-poly.
    // L'eix llarg és Z i la volta creua l'amplada X.
    const createHangarShell=({width,depth,height,wallColor,roofColor})=>{
      const group=new THREE.Group(),roofGroup=new THREE.Group(),walls=wallMaterial(wallColor),doors=doorMaterial();group.add(roofGroup);
      const floor=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(width+.5,.35,depth+.5),material(0x6f6d67,'masonry'));
      floor.position.y=.02;group.add(floor);

      // La volta arrenca pràcticament des de terra: el sostre forma també els laterals.
      const spring=.12,radius=Math.max(width*.5,2),segments=10,da=Math.PI/segments;
      const roofMat=material(roofColor,'metal'),slabs=[];
      for(let i=0;i<segments;i++){
        const a0=i*da,a1=(i+1)*da,a=(a0+a1)/2;
        const x=Math.cos(a)*radius,y=spring+Math.sin(a)*radius;
        const chord=2*radius*Math.sin(da/2);
        const slab=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(chord,.24,depth+1.15),roofMat);
        slab.position.set(x,y,0);
        slab.rotation.z=a-Math.PI/2;
        roofGroup.add(slab);slabs.push(slab);
      }
      batchStaticRoof(roofGroup,slabs);

      // Nervis exteriors per donar una lectura més propera a un hangar real.
      const frameMat=material(0x5c6366,'metal'),ribs=[];
      for(const z of[-depth/2+.7,0,depth/2-.7]){
        for(let i=0;i<segments;i++){
          const a=(i+.5)*da,x=Math.cos(a)*radius,y=spring+Math.sin(a)*radius,chord=2*radius*Math.sin(da/2);
          const rib=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(chord,.1,.12),frameMat);
          rib.position.set(x,y,z);rib.rotation.z=a-Math.PI/2;roofGroup.add(rib);ribs.push(rib);
        }
      }
      batchStaticRoof(roofGroup,ribs);
      roofGroup.userData.color=roofColor;
      roofGroup.userData.hangarRoof=true;
      roofGroup.userData.hitSegments=Array.from({length:segments},(_,i)=>{
        const a=(i+.5)*da,chord=2*radius*Math.sin(da/2);
        return {x:Math.cos(a)*radius,y:spring+Math.sin(a)*radius,a,chord,depth:depth+1.15}
      });
      return {group,walls,doors,roof:roofGroup,sideWalls:[],spring,archTop:spring+radius};
    };

    const addRamp=(group,{alongAxis,length,width,top,bottom,x,z,color,direction=1})=>{
      const rise=top-bottom,mid=(top+bottom)/2,angle=Math.atan2(rise,length);
      const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(alongAxis?length:width,.28,alongAxis?width:length),
        material(color,'masonry')
      );
      mesh.position.set(x,mid,z);
      if(alongAxis)mesh.rotation.z=-direction*angle;
      else mesh.rotation.x=direction*angle;
      mesh.userData.ramp=true;group.add(mesh);return mesh
    };

    const addStep=(group,{alongAxis,riseWidth,height,base,x,y,z,color})=>{
      const mesh=box(group,alongAxis?riseWidth:4.2,height-base,alongAxis?4.2:riseWidth,color,x,(height+base)/2,z,'masonry');
      mesh.userData.stair=true;return mesh
    };
    const createFlag=({x,y,z,color})=>{
      const group=new THREE.Group();
      const pole=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.18,.22,14,8),material(0xc9d1d6,'metal'));
      const cloth=new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(5.2,3,.16),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,flatShading:true,...materialProfile('paint')})
      );
      pole.position.set(0,7,0);cloth.position.set(2.65,12,0);
      group.position.set(x,y,z);group.add(pole,cloth);return group
    };
    return {createShell,createHangarShell,addWall,addDoor,addWindowedWall,addRamp,addStep,createFlag};
  }
});

;
// END src/buildings.js
// BEGIN src/general-model.js
window.HUNTER_GENERAL_MODEL=Object.freeze({create(T,{palette=window.HUNTER_PALETTE}={}){
 const index=1;
 const g=HUNTER_PLAYER_MODEL.create(T,{palette}),u=g.userData,h=u.head;
 const cfg={name:'ESTAT MAJOR',coat:0x681d30,lapel:0xda3143,hat:0x7e2030,hem:.92};
 const gold=0xe9bc52,dark=0x202327,skin=0xc99370;
 // Keep the current player rig and latest shoulder/elbow proportions; replace equipment with a coat.
 const joints=new Set([u.ll,u.lr,u.al,u.ar,h]);
 for(const o of [...g.children])if(!joints.has(o))g.remove(o);
 for(const [m,,]of u.mats)m.color.setHex(cfg.coat);
 g.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.material.color.getHex()===0xf0c9a0)o.material.color.setHex(skin)});
 h.remove(u.cap,u.visor);for(const o of [...h.children])if(o.material?.color.getHex()===0x162021)h.remove(o);
 const mats=new Map(),mat=c=>{if(!mats.has(c))mats.set(c,new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:c===gold?.43:.86,metalness:c===gold?.45:0,flatShading:true}));return mats.get(c)};
 const mesh=(pa,geo,c,x=0,y=0,z=0)=>{const m=new T.Mesh(geo,mat(c));m.position.set(x,y,z);m.castShadow=m.receiveShadow=true;pa.add(m);return m};
 const box=(pa,w,hh,d,c,x,y,z)=>mesh(pa,new T.BoxGeometry(w,hh,d),c,x,y,z);
 const oval=(pa,rx,ry,rz,c,x,y,z)=>{const m=mesh(pa,new T.SphereGeometry(1,12,6),c,x,y,z);m.scale.set(rx,ry,rz);return m};
 function taper(pa,top,bottom,height,depth,c,x,y,z){const geo=new T.CylinderGeometry(1,1,height,4,1,false,Math.PI/4);const a=geo.attributes.position;for(let i=0;i<a.count;i++){const upper=a.getY(i)>0;a.setX(i,a.getX(i)*(upper?top:bottom)/Math.SQRT2);a.setZ(i,a.getZ(i)*depth/Math.SQRT2)}geo.computeVertexNormals();return mesh(pa,geo,c,x,y,z)}
 taper(g,1.05,.86,1.17,.69,cfg.coat,0,2.32,0);
 mesh(g,new T.CylinderGeometry(.16,.18,.28,10),skin,0,3.02,0);
 // Split tails follow each thigh so the knees can flex below the coat.
 for(const side of[-1,1]){
  const hip=side<0?u.ll:u.lr,length=1.73-cfg.hem;
  taper(hip,.44,.58,length,.76,cfg.coat,side*.008,-length/2,.015);
  box(hip,.43,.045,.11,cfg.lapel,side*.02,-length+.15,-.402);
  const lapel=box(g,.22,.61,.07,cfg.lapel,side*.24,2.65,-.386);lapel.rotation.z=-side*.40;
  const collar=box(g,.23,.17,.36,cfg.lapel,side*.19,2.98,-.05);collar.rotation.z=-side*.24;
  const arm=side<0?u.al:u.ar;
  // Muscleres unides al pivot del braç: cobreixen l'espatlla també en flexió.
  box(arm,.38,.14,.38,gold,0,.115,0);
  box(arm,.30,.022,.30,0xf8d575,0,.196,0);
  for(let j=0;j<4;j++)box(arm,.027,.11,.024,gold,side*.187,.013,-.115+j*.076);
  const elbow=side<0?u.ael:u.aer;
  for(const y of[-.40,-.455])box(elbow,.27,.025,.29,gold,0,y,0);
 }
 box(g,.94,.13,.76,dark,0,1.86,0);box(g,.19,.15,.045,gold,0,1.86,-.401);box(g,.10,.08,.053,dark,0,1.86,-.415);
 // Double-breasted buttons and ten actual medal meshes, not a texture.
 for(const x of[-.10,.10])for(const y of[2.04,2.22,2.40])oval(g,.029,.029,.015,gold,x,y,-.395);
 const ribbon=[0xc52838,0x285880,0xd5d5bd,0x318562,0x553b82];
 for(let row=0;row<2;row++)for(let j=0;j<5;j++){
  const x=.08+j*.073,y=2.70-row*.21;
  box(g,.055,.09,.024,ribbon[(j+index)%5],x,y,-.445);
  const medal=mesh(g,new T.CylinderGeometry(.032,.032,.018,j%2?6:10),gold,x,y-.068,-.463);medal.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;
 }
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++)for(let k=0;k<3;k++)box(g,.065,.025,.025,ribbon[(j+k)%5],-.34+j*.07,2.64-k*.045,-.449);
 if(index===1||index===3){const cord=mesh(g,new T.TorusGeometry(.19,.018,5,14,Math.PI),gold,-.34,2.55,-.45);cord.rotation.z=Math.PI}
 // Broad, flat officer's cap with a dark band, peak and gold badge.
 const band=mesh(h,new T.CylinderGeometry(.346,.35,.13,14),dark,0,.22,0);band.scale.z=.97;
 const crown=mesh(h,new T.CylinderGeometry(index===1?.455:.43,.345,.17,14),cfg.hat,0,.36,0);crown.scale.z=.95;crown.rotation.x=-.07;
 oval(h,.32,.04,.28,dark,0,.16,-.29);
 const braid=mesh(h,new T.TorusGeometry(.285,.015,5,16,Math.PI),gold,0,.225,-.028);braid.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;
 box(h,.095,.09,.036,gold,0,.30,-.35);
 // Aviator teardrop lenses with visible metallic frames and double bridge.
 function lens(pa,side,c,scale,z){const shape=new T.Shape();shape.moveTo(-.12,.065);shape.quadraticCurveTo(.05,.11,.14,.05);shape.quadraticCurveTo(.14,-.08,.04,-.125);shape.quadraticCurveTo(-.11,-.13,-.13,-.025);shape.closePath();const m=mesh(pa,new T.ShapeGeometry(shape,5),c,side*.16,.055,z);m.scale.set(scale,scale,1);m.rotation.y=Math.PI;return m}
 for(const side of[-1,1]){lens(h,side,gold,1,-.348);lens(h,side,index===2?0x52656c:0x202c30,.84,-.355);box(h,.025,.025,.24,gold,side*.325,.09,-.23)}
 for(const y of[.09,.045])box(h,.08,.018,.025,gold,0,y,-.357);
 // Thick moustache, separated from the glasses and extending past the nose.
 for(const side of[-1,1]){const must=oval(h,.155,.065,.062,index===3?0x574338:0x30221b,side*.115,-.142,-.309);must.rotation.z=side*-.10;}
 // Keep the general's existing weapon and enemy-animation contracts.
 const gun=new T.Group();gun.position.set(0,-.6195,-.035);gun.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;u.aer.add(gun);
 box(gun,.16,.2,1.5,palette.enemy.metal,0,0,-.25);box(gun,.18,.36,.25,dark,0,-.24,0);box(gun,.18,.2,.45,0x66513c,0,0,.55);
 u.gun=gun;u.legs=[u.ll,u.lr];u.arms=[u.al,u.ar];u.knees=[u.lkl,u.lkr];u.elbows=[u.ael,u.aer];
 u.profile='general-approved-thick-epaulettes';
 // Escala visual del general al 80%; el pivot dels peus continua ancorat a terra.
 g.updateMatrixWorld(true);const bounds=new T.Box3().setFromObject(g),fit=3.55/(bounds.max.y-bounds.min.y);
 for(const child of g.children)child.position.y-=bounds.min.y;
 g.traverse(o=>{if(o!==g)o.position.multiplyScalar(fit);if(o.isMesh)o.geometry.scale(fit,fit,fit)});
 g.scale.setScalar(.8);
 return g;
}});

;
// END src/general-model.js
// BEGIN src/enemy-lod.js
// LOD visual dels enemics. La física i l'IA sempre conserven el model original.
(()=>{
const fullCache=new Map(),proxyCache=new Map(),proxyMaterials=new Map();
const material=T=>new T.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xffffff,vertexColors:true,flatShading:true,side:T.DoubleSide});
function bake(T,parts,cacheKey){
  if(cacheKey&&fullCache.has(cacheKey))return fullCache.get(cacheKey);
  const geos=[];let count=0;
  for(const {geometry,material:mat,matrix} of parts){
    if(!geometry?.attributes?.position||!mat?.color)continue;
    const g=geometry.index?geometry.toNonIndexed():geometry.clone();
    g.applyMatrix4(matrix);
    if(!g.attributes.normal)g.computeVertexNormals();
    geos.push({g,color:mat.color});count+=g.attributes.position.count;
  }
  if(!count)return null;
  const p=new Float32Array(count*3),n=new Float32Array(count*3),c=new Float32Array(count*3);
  let start=0;
  for(const {g,color} of geos){
    const pos=g.attributes.position,norm=g.attributes.normal,local=g.attributes.color;
    for(let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){
      const k=(start+i)*3;
      p[k]=pos.getX(i);p[k+1]=pos.getY(i);p[k+2]=pos.getZ(i);
      n[k]=norm.getX(i);n[k+1]=norm.getY(i);n[k+2]=norm.getZ(i);
      c[k]=color.r*(local?local.getX(i):1);
      c[k+1]=color.g*(local?local.getY(i):1);
      c[k+2]=color.b*(local?local.getZ(i):1);
    }
    start+=pos.count;g.dispose();
  }
  const g=new T.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new T.BufferAttribute(p,3));
  g.setAttribute('normal',new T.BufferAttribute(n,3));
  g.setAttribute('color',new T.BufferAttribute(c,3));
  g.computeBoundingSphere();
  if(cacheKey)fullCache.set(cacheKey,g);
  return g;
}
function mergeRig(T,model,type){
  const groups=[];model.traverse(o=>{if(o.isGroup)groups.push(o)});
  const sharedMaterial=material(T);
  let before=0,after=0,batchIndex=0;
  for(const pivot of groups){
    const meshes=pivot.children.filter(o=>o.isMesh&&!o.isSkinnedMesh&&o.material?.color&&
      !Array.isArray(o.material)&&!o.material.map);
    before+=meshes.length;
    if(meshes.length<2){after+=meshes.length;continue}
    const data=meshes.map(m=>{m.updateMatrix();return {geometry:m.geometry,material:m.material,matrix:m.matrix}});
    const geo=bake(T,data,type+':pivot:'+batchIndex++);
    if(!geo){after+=meshes.length;continue}
    const merged=new T.Mesh(geo,sharedMaterial);
    merged.name='hunter-enemy-articulated-batch';merged.userData.enemyBatched=true;
    merged.castShadow=merged.receiveShadow=true;
    for(const mesh of meshes)pivot.remove(mesh);
    pivot.add(merged);after++;
    for(const geo of new Set(meshes.map(m=>m.geometry)))geo.dispose();
  }
  return {before,after};
}
function proxy(T,type,level){
  const key=type+':'+level;
  if(proxyCache.has(key))return proxyCache.get(key);
  const parts=[],mid=level==='mid';
  const box=(x,y,z,w,h,d,color)=>parts.push({
    geometry:new T.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),
    material:{color:new T.Color(color)},
    matrix:new T.Matrix4().makeTranslation(x,y,z)
  });
  if(type==='soldat'||type==='general'){
    const officer=type==='general',body=officer?0x681d30:0x546b48,
      trim=officer?0x812735:0x667b50,skin=officer?0xc99370:0xd6ad86;
    box(0,2.28,0,1,1.17,.65,body);
    box(0,3.18,0,.62,.62,.62,skin);
    box(0,3.52,0,.73,.18,.7,officer?0x7e2030:0x526349);
    for(const side of [-1,1]){
      box(side*.3,.88,0,.31,1.7,.39,trim);
      if(mid)box(side*.65,2.33,-.02,.27,1.12,.3,body);
    }
    if(mid){
      box(0,2.3,.43,.61,.85,.2,0x2b3530);
      box(.51,2.36,-.53,.12,.15,1.05,0x2a3030);
      if(officer)box(0,2.88,-.37,.67,.13,.09,0xd8b557);
    }
  }else if(type==='torre'){
    const metal=0x4c5358;
    for(const x of [-1.42,1.42])for(const z of (mid?[-1.42,1.42]:[0]))
      box(x,3.9,z,.37,7.8,.4,metal);
    box(0,8.1,0,4.15,.55,4.15,metal);
    box(0,9.1,0,2.9,1.55,2.9,0x812f35);
    box(0,10.23,0,3.5,.32,3.5,0x373c40);
  }else if(type==='patrulla_marina'){
    box(0,.54,0,3.2,1.03,8.9,0x626e71);
    box(0,1.38,.85,2.45,.52,2.8,0x556166);
    box(0,1.71,-.65,2.25,.58,.12,0x313e48);
    if(mid)for(const x of[-.65,.65]){
      box(x,2.05,1.22,.52,1.3,.52,0x586549);
      box(x,2.85,1.22,.44,.46,.44,0xc18b64);
      box(x,2.08,-.65,.44,.35,1.4,0x363c39);
    }
  }else{
    const heavy=type==='tanc'||type==='tanqueta',
      humvee=type==='jeep',
      // Enemy jeep maps to the exact same cotxe D3.1 at 175% as the player.
      // Distant proxy must preserve its ~4.6 × 8.2 metre footprint.
      w=type==='tanc'?5.8:type==='tanqueta'?4.2:humvee?4.65:3.1,
      l=type==='tanc'?7:type==='tanqueta'?5.2:humvee?8.18:5.2;
    if(humvee){
      box(0,1.10,0,w,1.6,l,0x687658);
      box(0,2.55,.35,w*.80,1.15,l*.43,0x56654e);
      if(mid){
        for(const x of [-w*.46,w*.46])for(const z of [-l*.32,l*.32])
          box(x,.88,z,.57,1.55,.70,0x232c28);
        box(0,1.30,-l*.485,w*.36,.35,.12,0x343d38);
      }
    }else{
      box(0,.88,0,w,1.25,l,heavy?0x626a48:0x656f59);
      box(0,1.84,0,w*.73,heavy?.9:1.3,l*.46,heavy?0x536047:0x3e4d46);
      if(mid){
        for(const x of [-w*.47,w*.47]){
          if(heavy)box(x,.59,0,.48,1.03,l*.9,0x242e2a);
          else for(const z of [-l*.31,l*.31])box(x,.53,z,.42,.98,.66,0x232a28);
        }
        if(heavy)box(0,2.17,-l*.38,.2,.2,l*.8,0x3e4540);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=bake(T,parts);
  for(const p of parts)p.geometry.dispose();
  proxyCache.set(key,geo);
  return geo;
}
function optimize(T,model,type){
  // La metralladora i les plaques del soldat d'elit no poden compartir
  // la geometria fusionada en memòria amb els soldats normals.
  const reduction=(type==='soldat'||type==='general')?mergeRig(T,model,type+(model.userData.eliteSoldier?'-elite':'')):null;
  const full=new T.Group();full.name='hunter-enemy-full';
  for(const child of [...model.children])full.add(child);
  model.add(full);
  let mat=proxyMaterials.get(type);
  if(!mat){mat=material(T);proxyMaterials.set(type,mat)}
  const mid=new T.Mesh(proxy(T,type,'mid'),mat),far=new T.Mesh(proxy(T,type,'far'),mat);
  mid.name='hunter-enemy-mid';far.name='hunter-enemy-far';
  if(type==='soldat'&&model.userData.eliteSoldier){
    const armor=new T.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x303a34}),mark=new T.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0xb83f38});
    for(const lod of [mid,far]){
      const plate=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(1.18,.78,.21),armor);
      plate.position.set(0,2.45,-.4);lod.add(plate);
      const stripe=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(.58,.13,.04),mark);
      stripe.position.set(0,2.75,-.53);lod.add(stripe);
      const gun=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(.16,.17,1.65),armor);
      gun.position.set(.4,2.25,-.85);lod.add(gun);
    }
  }
  mid.userData.noCastShadow=true;far.userData.noCastShadow=true;
  mid.castShadow=far.castShadow=mid.receiveShadow=far.receiveShadow=false;
  mid.visible=far.visible=false;
  model.add(mid,far);
  model.userData.enemyFullRoot=full;
  model.userData.enemyMidMesh=mid;
  model.userData.enemyFarMesh=far;
  model.userData.enemyLOD='full';
  model.userData.enemyLODCounts=reduction;
  return model;
}
function setLevel(model,level){
  const u=model?.userData;
  if(!u?.enemyFullRoot||u.enemyLOD===level)return false;
  u.enemyLOD=level;
  u.enemyFullRoot.visible=level==='full';
  u.enemyMidMesh.visible=level==='mid';
  u.enemyFarMesh.visible=level==='far';
  return true;
}
window.HUNTER_ENEMY_LOD=Object.freeze({
  optimize,setLevel,
  reset(){fullCache.clear();proxyCache.clear();},
  stats(){return {fullGroups:fullCache.size,proxyGeometries:proxyCache.size}}
});
})();

;
